recentItems.title: Mumbai Floods Again: Heavy Rain Paralyzes City, Orange Alert Ahead Of Ganesh Chaturthi | WATCH
recentItems.description:
Mumbai is battling intense rainfall and widespread waterlogging, disrupting normal life across the city and adjoining areas. Several roads have been affected, leaving commuters and motorists struggling as more showers are forecast. An orange alert has been issued for Mumbai and Thane ahead of Ganesh Chaturthi, raising concerns over further disruption.

recentItems.description:

Several nearby buildings were also damaged in the attack. This comes even as the Yemen-based rebels claim that they're targeting only military bases in Saudi Arabia. Watch to know in detail
